voice_studio_project_context.name: Design for the Real World
voice_studio_project_context.meaning: Voice Studio project inside the TTS-Research app, not a ChatGPT project

rules: Keep at least one concrete lane active while Linear issues remain: subagent delegation, tracked supervisor/process, or explicit waiting-on-peer item.
Parent session owns orchestration, PM, evidence, review dispatch, final gates, commit, push, and Linear closeout; focused subagents own product-code implementation and repair.
Use ChatGPT Project as an advisory peer checkpoint with fresh archive/checkpoint evidence; repo, Linear, and local gates remain source of truth.
Do not mark issues Done from implementation alone; require parent verification, independent review, and ChatGPT peer review when the slice needs external checkpoint evidence.
